newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: BES shares firm after H1 profit surge.
newsitem.headline: BES shares firm after H1 profit surge.

text.p: Shares in Portuguese bank Banco Espirito Santo reacted positively to the 43 percent increase in consolidated first half profit, but the share was not expected to exceed the day's high of 4,500 escudos, dealers said.
"The results were very good, and slightly above expectations, but I doubt that the they will climb above 4,500 escudos, at least for now," said one operator.
BES shares hit a high of 4,500 escudos after the opening, and later eased back to 4,450 escudos, up 35, in volume of 321,557 at 1003 GMT.
